scripts.//: Checkpoint G — the browser-driving gates MUST run serially. node --test runs test FILES in parallel; several Phase 02/03 files start a full Octagon server AND a Chromium instance, the machine saturates, and a 30s Puppeteer wait times out ('role-specific navigation hides privileged pages'). That is resource starvation, not a product defect. Running these gates with --test-concurrency=1 makes them pass (Phase 02: 11/11, exit 0). Do not 'fix' a timeout here by raising the wait.
